rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Innovation Administration Division ), 044-201-3220, 3215

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 대도시권광역교통위원회에 두는 보조기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원과 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제4항에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「대도시권광역교통위원회 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Metropolitan Area Transportation Committee,” such as the ranks and staffing levels of auxiliary agencies placed under the Metropolitan Area Transportation Committee, and the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary agencies placed under the Director pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the “Government Organization Act, ” as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(상임위원) 상임위원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Standing Members) Standing members shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기획총괄과) ① 기획총괄과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Planning and General Affairs Division) ① The Head of the Planning and General Affairs Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(광역교통정책국) ① 광역교통정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Metropolitan Transportation Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Metropolitan Transportation Policy Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 광역교통정책국에 광역교통정책과ㆍ광역버스과 및 광역교통경제과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Metropolitan Transport Policy Bureau shall have the Metropolitan Transport Policy Division, the Metropolitan Bus Division, and the Metropolitan Transport Economy Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 광역교통정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Metropolitan Transportation Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대도시권 광역교통 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of metropolitan area transportation policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 대도시권 광역교통기본계획의 수립 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for the establishment of metropolitan area transportation master plans

rows.source_ko: 3. 대도시권 광역교통시행계획의 수립ㆍ시행

rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the establishment of annual implementation plans and the review of execution performance of the Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation Implementation Plan

rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and implementation of metropolitan transportation improvement measures

rows.text_en: 5-2. Establishment and Implementation of Special Measures for Metropolitan Transportation

rows.text_en: 5-3. Designation and Revocation of Metropolitan Transportation Special Measures Districts

rows.source_ko: 6. 광역교통시설 부담금 제도의 운용 및 제도 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the operation and improvement of the metropolitan transportation facility surcharge system

rows.source_ko: 7. 광역교통시설 부담금 사용계획에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the plan for the use of metropolitan transportation facility charges

rows.source_ko: 8. 대도시권 광역교통시설 지정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the designation of metropolitan area wide-area transportation facilities

rows.source_ko: 9. 대도시권 광역교통시설의 연계 및 기능 분담에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the linkage and functional division of metropolitan area wide-area transportation facilities

rows.source_ko: 10. 대도시권 광역교통체계와 관련된 갈등관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning conflict management related to metropolitan area wide-area transportation systems

rows.source_ko: 11. 대도시권 권역별 광역교통축의 지정
rows.text_en: 11. Designation of Metropolitan Transportation Axes by Region in Metropolitan Areas

rows.source_ko: 11의2. 광역교통축별 광역교통대책의 마련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11-2. Matters concerning the preparation of metropolitan transportation measures by metropolitan transportation axis

rows.source_ko: 11의3. 대도시권 권역별 광역교통 관련 협의체의 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11-3. Matters concerning the composition and operation of consultative bodies related to metropolitan transportation by region within metropolitan areas

rows.source_ko: 12. 대도시권 광역교통 수요관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the management of wide-area transportation demand in metropolitan areas

rows.source_ko: 13. 대도시권광역교통위원회(이하 “위원회”라 한다), 법 제9조제4항에 따른 실무위원회 및 법 제9조의5에 따른 권역별 위원회 안건 상정 및 사후관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the submission of agenda items and follow-up management of the Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”), the Working Committee pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 4 of the Act, and the Regional Committees pursuant to Article 9-5 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 14. 대도시권 광역교통 정책에 관한 국제협력 업무
rows.text_en: 14. International cooperation affairs regarding metropolitan area transportation policies

rows.source_ko: 15. 대도시권 광역교통 분야의 초광역협력에 대한 지원
rows.text_en: 15. Support for trans-regional cooperation in the metropolitan transportation sector

rows.source_ko: 16. 대도시권 범위의 조정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 16. Matters concerning the adjustment of the scope of metropolitan areas

rows.source_ko: 17. 탄소중립 실현을 위한 광역교통체계 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Matters concerning the establishment of a metropolitan transportation system for the realization of carbon neutrality

rows.source_ko: ④ 광역버스과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Metropolitan Bus Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대도시권 광역급행형ㆍ직행좌석형 시내버스(이하 “광역버스”라 한다) 노선의 총괄계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan for metropolitan express and express seated city bus routes (hereinafter referred to as “Metropolitan Buses”)

rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the approval of changes to business plans and the acceptance of notifications for metropolitan wide-area bus transportation businesses

rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the licensing of metropolitan wide-area buses

rows.source_ko: 5. 대도시권 광역버스 운송사업자의 운송약관 및 그 변경신고의 수리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the terms and conditions of transportation of metropolitan wide-area bus operators and the acceptance of notifications of changes thereto

rows.source_ko: 6. 대도시권 광역버스 운송사업자에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 6. Guidance and Supervision of Metropolitan Area Intercity Bus Operators

rows.source_ko: 7. 대도시권 광역버스 준공영제 도입ㆍ지원에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 12. 대도시권 광역버스 증ㆍ감차 관리 및 배차 효율화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the management of increases and decreases in the number of intercity buses in metropolitan areas and the optimization of dispatch efficiency

rows.source_ko: 13. 대도시권 광역버스 예약시스템 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the management of the metropolitan wide-area bus reservation system

rows.source_ko: 15. 대도시권 광역대중교통시설 운영자 및 광역버스 운송사업자에 대한 경영ㆍ서비스 평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 15. Matters concerning the management and service evaluation of operators of metropolitan area public transportation facilities and intercity bus transportation business operators

rows.source_ko: 16. 대도시권 광역버스 현황의 조사ㆍ분석 및 통계 관리

rows.source_ko: 17. 대도시권 광역버스를 이용하는 이동약자의 편의 증진을 위한 정책 수립 및 제도 개선
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment of policies and improvement of systems to enhance convenience for the mobility-impaired using metropolitan wide-area buses

rows.source_ko: 18. 대도시권 광역버스 통합 정보시스템의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 18. Establishment and Operation of the Integrated Information System for Metropolitan Area Intercity Buses

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 광역교통경제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Metropolitan Transportation and Economy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대도시권 광역대중교통 기본요금 기준에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the basic fare standards for metropolitan area public transportation

rows.source_ko: 2. 대도시권 통합 환승요금 정산 방법에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the settlement method for integrated transfer fares in metropolitan areas

rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning data sharing and utilization among agencies related to integrated transfer fares in metropolitan areas

rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the composition and operation of the Metropolitan Area Taxi Transportation Business Deliberation and Coordination Committee

rows.source_ko: 9. 대도시권 도시철도운영자, 철도사업자 등 연락운송 관련 협의 및 분쟁에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning consultations and disputes regarding inter-transportation with metropolitan area urban railway operators, railway operators, etc.

rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the analysis of metropolitan area wide-area transportation databases and related policies

rows.source_ko: 10의2. 교통카드ㆍ보행ㆍ자전거이용 데이터 등의 교통데이터를 활용한 대중교통 활성화 지원 사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10-2. Matters concerning support projects for the revitalization of public transportation utilizing transportation data, such as transportation card, walking, and bicycle usage data

rows.source_ko: 11. 대도시권 교통조사 및 교통수요 분석에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning traffic surveys and traffic demand analysis in metropolitan areas

rows.source_ko: 12. 대도시권 광역교통 통합 빅데이터플랫폼 구축ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of an integrated big data platform for metropolitan area transportation

rows.source_ko: 13. 대도시권 광역교통정보의 제공 및 관련 산업 지원에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 14. Establishment, Management, Analysis, and Utilization of Traffic Statistics Related to Metropolitan Area Transportation Facilities, Transport Businesses, and Users

rows.text_en: 16. Development and Dissemination of Demand-Responsive Metropolitan Transportation Services

rows.source_ko: 17. 대도시권 통합교통서비스(MaaS)의 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Establishment and Operation of Metropolitan Area Integrated Transportation Services (MaaS)

rows.source_ko: 18. 대도시권 광역교통서비스 수준에 대한 조사 및 평가
rows.text_en: 18. Survey and Evaluation of the Level of Metropolitan Area Transportation Services

rows.source_ko: 제5조(광역교통운영국) ① 광역교통운영국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Metropolitan Transportation Operations Bureau) ① The Director of the Metropolitan Transportation Operations Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 광역교통운영국에 광역시설정책과ㆍ광역교통도로과 및 광역환승과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Metropolitan Transport Operations Bureau shall have the Metropolitan Facilities Policy Division, the Metropolitan Transport and Roads Division, and the Metropolitan Transfer Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 광역시설정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 2. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Metropolitan Facilities Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대도시권 광역교통시설의 구축ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
